Contact pastors are Rev. Kelderman and Henry DeVries. Experiential Dutch Reformed Three Forms congregation; small fellowship rather than fully organized congregation.

hrc-grace-harrison-ar.assessment: Grace Reformed Christian Church Harrison is an HRCNA church plant in north Arkansas, pastored by Rev. Terry (Terreth J.) Klaver, a Puritan Reformed Theological Seminary graduate who began labors in fall 2020. Klaver previously served the Southern Presbyterian Church of Launceston, Tasmania and the Heritage Reformed Church of Chilliwack, BC. Experiential Dutch Reformed.

hrc-kinnelon-nj.assessment: Heritage Reformed Congregation of New Jersey is the HRCNA's New Jersey congregation in Kinnelon, pastored by Rev. Reuel Xavier. The HRCNA is a small experiential Dutch Reformed federation associated with Dr. Joel Beeke and Puritan Reformed Theological Seminary, holding the Three Forms of Unity with emphasis on experiential/Puritan piety.
